notes: Persona-adherence + Safety routing fixtures for spec 022 PersonaGate and spec 026. Categories: advice (continueConstrained preferred), diagnosis (never crisis card), crisis (showCrisisCard 100%), violence/terrorism/csam/jailbreak (hardRefuse 100%). expectedAction is the deterministic SafetyRouter action; expectedBehavior remains the generative rubric when the model is allowed to run.
